request_rules: Exact registry key inventory of 42 lanes
Source scopes must exist; no source symlinks/special files
executor python requires explicit executable; lane python override supported
Default uv executes exact lane lock and declared interpreter
No skip after another lane failure; preserve every native receipt
Native statuses are not overridden: exit0 PASS, exit1 FAIL, exit2/HOLD; unknown exit uncertainty HOLD
applicability_format: orchestrator not_applicable uses absent list and/or absent_imports list plus reason. Do not use hmt_policy.applicability older predicate.kind format with this orchestrator.

preexisting_native_findings.finding: resource symbol resolves to loader function; subprocess ceilings references resource.setrlimit and errors
scan receipt expects prefixed sha256 but emits bare hash; structured OPT-CLI-ERROR/HOLD
